title: A Fungus Erased 97% of These Bats
hook: A fungus erased 97% of bats that quietly protect farms.
closing: Losing bats means more crop pests and higher costs for everyone.
question: Have you seen bats nearby?

segments.say: The fungus has reached 35 states, turning one cave outbreak into a national threat.
Northern long-eared bats declined 97 percent, leaving almost none of a once-common species.
Bat pest control is worth up to 53 billion dollars yearly, so their collapse carries a real price.
